rep.partial_message: Pull higher, until your chin clears the bar.

checks.label: Swinging
checks.message: Stop swinging. Squeeze your glutes and keep your legs still.

checks.label: Chin below the bar
checks.message: Pull until your chin clears the bar.

checks.label: Not hanging fully
checks.message: Lower all the way until your arms are straight.

camera.title: Film from the side
steps: Prop your phone or laptop 2.5 to 3 m away, at about hip height, so the camera sees you side-on (90 degrees).
Keep your whole body in frame, from your head to your feet, and leave some space above and below.
Light the room from the front or above. A bright window behind you makes the camera lose your outline.
Wear fitted clothing so your joints are visible. Keep the weights or machine from covering the side facing the camera.
camera.note: Camera side-on at mid-height so the bar, your hands and your hips stay in frame. On an assisted machine the pad may cover your legs; that is fine.

guidance.accuracy: Free-weight lifts are the best case for a single camera: the joints that matter are visible and move in a plane the camera can see. Treat the feedback as a second pair of eyes, not a coach: a camera in 2D cannot see rotation or depth, and a lifter in the wrong clothes or light will confuse it.
